tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full details of a single product by its id (as returned by search_products). Read-only.

tools.name: go_to_page
tools.description: Navigate the current browser tab to a shop page (product, category or any internal path). Accepts only same-origin absolute paths starting with "/".

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the shop category tree (id, name, url, parent_id, products_count). Read-only, backed by a static build-time feed.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the shop product catalog by name or brand. Read-only, backed by a static build-time feed. Returns matching products with price, availability and product page URL.
